clarity.notes: Each page answers one operator question per zone: breadcrumb (where), PH1 head (what), toolbar (how). Independent MCP signals kept visible without the 6-column matrix; config signal is implicit since every listed server is configured.

hierarchy.notes: Canonical route stack from design-system.html §03: topbar → page head → listing toolbar → rows. One accent CTA per viewport; status carried by tint pills, not borders.

typography.notes: Inter UI + JetBrains Mono for refs/endpoints/enums, verbatim token block from packages/ui lineage. Mono row titles for machine names (refs, server names, profile names) per listing standard.

motion.notes: 140ms token transitions, sheet slide, skeleton shimmer, phased authorize dialog (begin → URL → confirmed). Full prefers-reduced-motion guard on all three pages.

brand.notes: All copy lifted from production strings (empty/error/dialog/banner text); enums and field shapes mirror internal contracts (VaultSecretPayload, SettingsMCPServerEntry, SettingsSandboxEntry). No invented metrics, controls, or reveal affordances the daemon does not support.
